_comment: Hand-maintained. Per hero: 'moves' = texture keys per move (attack, kick, heavy, hurt, stun, knockdown, fly, ko, win), 'left' = keys that also have a hand-drawn left-facing '<key>_L' texture. The <sprite>_hit1..N poses (heroRoster.json 'hits', built by tools/build-sprites.py) are always the 'attack' pool; listing one of them here as 'kick' or 'heavy' makes the director prefer it for that kind of blow (a heavy one = the last blow of a round and the finale's knockout).
